fragments.text: Hello?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 你好？

fragments.text: Oh hello. My name's Jan. Are you the right person to talk to about the Buckworth Conservation Group?

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 哦你好。我叫简。请问你是巴克沃斯保护组织的对接人吗？

fragments.text: Yes, I'm Peter. I'm the

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 是的，我是彼得。我是秘书。

fragments.text: Good. I've just moved to this area, and I'm interested in
. I was in a similar group where I used to live. Could you tell me something about your
please?

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 好的。我刚搬到这个地区，我很想参与其中。我在之前生活的地方参加过类似的组织。你能告诉我一些你们的活动吗？

fragments.text: Of course. Well, we have a
of regular activities and

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 当然。嗯，我们有常规活动和特殊活动。

fragments.text: One of the regular ones is trying to keep the beach free of litter. A few of us
a month on it, and it's awful how much there is to clear.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 其中一项日常工作是清理海滩的垃圾。我们几个人每个月都要花几小时才能完成。要清理的垃圾很多，让人很不愉快。

fragments.text: I wish people would be more
and take it home with them.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 我希望人们能够更加负责，把垃圾带回家。

fragments.text: I totally agree. I'd be happy to help with that. Is it OK to take dogs?

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 我完全同意。我很乐意帮忙。带狗可以吗？

fragments.text: I'm afraid not, as they're
from the beach itself. You can take them along the
though. And children are welcome.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 恐怕不行，因为海滩区域本身不允许它们进入。不过你可以带它们沿着悬崖走走。

fragments.text: Right.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: We also manage a
and there's a lot to do there all year round.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 我们还管理一个自然保护区，全年都有很多事情可做。

fragments.text: For example, because it's a popular place to visit, we spend a lot of time looking after the
and making sure they're in
for walking.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 例如，因为这是一个受欢迎的地方，我们会花很多时间打理道路，确保它们方便行走。

fragments.text: I could certainly help with that.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 我完全可以帮忙。

fragments.text: Good. And we have a programme of creating
there. We've just finished making and installing
for birds to use, and next we're going to work on encouraging insects - they're important for the
of the reserve.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 好的。我们计划在那里创造新的栖息地。我们刚刚完成并安装了供鸟类使用的筑巢盒，接下来我们将致力于促进昆虫的繁殖——它们对保护区的生物多样性很重要。

fragments.text: Oh, and we're also
a project to identify the different species of
that visit the reserve. You might be interested in taking part in that.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 哦，我们还在进行一个项目，鉴定到访保护区的不同种类的蝴蝶。你可能会有兴趣参加。

fragments.text: Sure. I was involved in something similar where I used to live, counting all the species of moths. I'd enjoy that.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 当然。我在曾经生活过的地方参与了一项类似的工作，计算所有飞蛾的种类。我会乐于其中。

fragments.text: Another job we're doing at the reserve is replacing the wall on the southern side, between the parking area and our woodshed. It was
in a storm last month.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 我们在保护区做的另一项工作是更换南面的墙，也就是停车场和我们的木棚之间的墙。它在上个月的一场风暴中严重受损。

fragments.text: OK.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: Then as I said, we have
of events as well, both at the weekend, and during the week.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 就像我说的，我们在周末和工作日都有活动安排。

fragments.text: Right. I presume you have guided walks? I'd like to get to know the
as I'm new to the area.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 是的。我猜你们有导游陪同徒步吧？我想了解一下当地的农村郊野，因为我是新来的。

fragments.text: Yes, we do. The next walk is to Ruston Island, a week on Saturday. We'll be meeting in the car park at Dunsmore Beach at low tide - that's when the sands are dry enough for us to walk to the island without getting wet.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 是的，我们有。接下来是去拉斯顿岛，周六出发持续一个星期。我们将在退潮时在邓斯莫尔海滩的停车场见面——那时沙子足够干，我们可以走到岛上而不被弄湿。

fragments.text: Sounds good.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 听起来不错。

fragments.text: The island's a great place to
. It's quite small, and it's got a range of habitats. It's also an ideal location for seeing seals just off the
, or even on the beach.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 这座岛是一个值得探索的好地方。它很小，有很多栖息地。它也是一个理想的在海岸，甚至在海滩上看海豹的地点。

fragments.text: OK. And is there anything we should bring, like a picnic, for instance?

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 好。有什么要带的吗，比如野餐之类的？

fragments.text: Yes, do bring one, as it's a full-day walk. And of course it'll be wet walking across and back, so make sure your boots are

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 是的，一定要带一个，因为要走一整天。当然，来回走会很湿，所以确保你的靴子是防水的。

fragments.text: I must buy a new pair - there's a hole in one of my current ones! Well, I'd
like to come on the walk.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 我必须买双新的，我现在穿的那双有个洞！好吧，我真的非常想来这个徒步。

fragments.text: Great. Then later this month we're having a one-day
in Hopton Wood.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 太好了。这个月晚些时候我们会在霍普顿森林举办为期一天的木工课程。

fragments.text: I've never tried that before. Is it OK for beginners to take part?

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 我以前从没试过。初学者可以参加吗？

fragments.text: Definitely. There'll be a couple of
leading the session, and we keep the number of
down, so you'll get as much help as you need.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 当然。会有几位专家主导课程，我们会控制参与者的人数，这样你们就能得到尽可能多的帮助。

fragments.text: Excellent! I'd love to be able to make chairs.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 太好了！我很想能做些椅子。

fragments.text: That's probably too ambitious for one day! You'll be starting with
and of course learning how to use the tools. And anything you make is yours to take home with you.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 对于一天的课程来说，可能野心太大了些！你将从木制勺子开始，当然还要学习如何使用这些工具。你做的任何东西都可以带回家。

fragments.text: That sounds like fun. When is it?

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 听起来很有趣。它是什么时候？

fragments.text: It's on the 17th, from 10 a.m. until 3. There's a
£35, including lunch, or £40 if you want to camp in the wood.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.translation: 17号，上午10点到3点。费用是35英镑，包括午餐，如果你想在树林里露营，费用是40英镑。

fragments.text: I should think I'll come home the same day. Well, I'd
like to join the group.

sentences.speaker: Jan
sentences.translation: 我想我当天就回家。我很想加入这个小组。
